(1) WEIGHT: news_weight.js computes W = F x (P + K + I), 0-100: P = 40 x share of verified events with abs z15d > 2 read from research/news_effects_2026-11/news_events.csv (CPI 24, FOMC 12, NFP 10, PPI 3, every other class 3); K from the page's own BTC 1m feed since the headline minute (abs z15d >= 2 and vr5 >= 4 -> 20, abs z15d >= 4 -> 40, else 0;

(cont.) z15d on the prior-24h 1m stdev, never the prior hour); I = 2 x Tree importance; F = 1 for 15 min then linear to 0 at 60 min; before a scheduled t0 W = P + I; overlap within 4 h halves P; hover lists P K I F with SOURCED or OURS per part; test test_weight_parts (CPI with move z 7.6 v 28 importance 10 at 2 min = 84; unknown class, no move, importance 9 = 21).

(2) BIAS: chip HOLD by default; LONG or SHORT only when K >= 20, the BTC move sign agrees and no opposite 'prior' tag; HOLD when K < 20, when prior and move disagree, when more than 35 min passed, when another event is within 4 h, and always for PPI; one reason word per chip; tests test_bias_hold_default, test_bias_long_short_on_move, test_bias_hold_late_overlap_ppi.

(3) FLASH: tab pulses when W >= 60 or K = 40; stops when he opens the tab, when W falls under 60, or at 60 min; re-flash once on a new qualifying item or a LONG<->SHORT flip, never on a flip to HOLD; at most one flash per headline; tests test_flash_when, test_flash_stop.

(4) REPEAT: no decay factor in W; the last same-class move (date, r15, z15d, vr5) is shown; the word 'flushed last time' when the previous same-class vr5 > 15; the previous sign never sets the chip; test test_repeat_no_decay.

(5) CLASSES: per section 2, 'prior' tags only for ETF (LONG/SHORT by wording), hack SHORT, geopolitics SHORT, hot CPI SHORT, cool CPI LONG; no tag for TRUMP_POLICY, TARIFF_TRADE, COURT_LEGAL, PROTOCOL, BOJ_JAPAN; no source tier, no corroboration bonus, no era term; test test_class_table_calls.

(6) news_study.py prints per class the 15 m and 60 m BTC move after each sample item on public 1m klines (counts only, no edge claim); REQUIREMENTS.md gets the section; page rebuilt and shipped; Result names the build and the 8 test names.
